title: ARBA2GO issue: GO:0061982	 meiosis I cell cycle process IEA with ARBA00029091

author: Antonialock
body:
do you think this term should be do_not_annotate? It doesn't really say what the gene product does, just when it operates. 
Mlh1 _does_ operate as part of GO:0000710 meiotic mismatch repair (is a meiosis I cell cycle process). Pombe seems to be missing the meiosis-specific components, so it uses the same machinery as during mitosis. For comparison, Pombe Pms1 is annotated to meiotic mismatch repair.

From pmid:31712578 : Sz. pombe has a streamlined nuclear mismatch repair system consisting of MutSα (Msh2-Msh6), MutSβ (Msh2-Msh3), and a single MutL (MutLα, Mlh1-Pms1). Importantly, the meiotic pro-crossover factors MutSγ (Msh4-Msh5), the meiosis-specific MutLγ component Mlh3, and Mlh2 – a MutLβ-homolog and a modulator of meiotic gene conversion tract length – are all missing in fission yeast

author: pgaudet
body:
Hi @Antonialock 

We have two branches: 'xx phase' and 'xx process'. GO:0061982 meiosis I cell cycle process is not a phase, it's considered a process, not 'when' the gene acts or the process happens. The phase branch for meiosis I is GO:0098764 'meiosis I cell cycle phase'. 

But indeed, this is quite a general term, we should make it do not annotate', as well as GO:0061983 meiosis II cell cycle process, for consistency. 

Thanks, Pascale

author: pgaudet
source_title: Add gocheck_do_not_annotate to meiosis I and II cell cycle process
